description: One lighthearted developer roast aimed at a target YOU choose - javascript, python, css, git, regex, kubernetes, agile or legacy code - and at the severity you ask for. Every other roast endpoint returns something generic; this one lets a code-review agent roast the actual stack in front of it. Bilingual, seedable and repeat-free. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

exclude.description: Ids already seen, comma-separated in a GET.

seed.description: Same seed always returns the same roast.

severity.description: mild | medium | savage. Omit for any.

target.description: javascript | python | css | git | regex | kubernetes | agile | legacy. Omit for any.

name: content_roast
title: Developer roast, on a target you pick
